_comment: Battle achievements (1.5 M28), shown in this order on the battle hub's Rewards page. stat is a number a battle gives (AchievementStats in PetAchievements.cs): wins, defeated, bosses, combos, flawless, clutch, hardWin, quickWin, heldHits, throwHits, ropesCut, rages, bubbles, ghosts, iceBreaks, fullBasket, coins, endlessWaves, popups, quakeHits. scope total adds it up over every battle; battle needs it in one battle. reward (optional) is a coat in coats.json or an accessory in accessories.json whose reward is "achievement"; each is given by one achievement. Battles with a custom battle.json count nothing. Rebuild the app after editing.
